spec.note: Pete 2026-10-13: female goose outfit by text-to-image (1920s lady cyclist chosen), partner to outfit_male_cyclist: same palette (brown herringbone, mustard, dark green, cream).
spec.outfit: a 1920s lady cyclist's outfit -- a close-fitting bell-shaped cloche hat in dark green felt with a mustard grosgrain ribbon band and a small flat bow on one side; a cream blouse with a rounded Peter Pan collar and a small dark green ribbon bow at the throat; a fitted long-sleeved cardigan in mustard ribbed knit, buttoned down the front with small brown buttons, a ribbed hem at the hips and ribbed cuffs; a knee-length knife-pleated skirt in brown herringbone tweed with a waistband; knee-high argyle socks in dark green and cream; brown leather T-bar shoes with a low block heel and a buckle; short cream cotton gloves at the wrists
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real fabric textures, clean tailoring, every garment complete and well fitted to the goose's body. The goose keeps its own head exactly: black head and neck, white cheek patch, eyes and beak unchanged. The goose has NO tail.
